title: The Clock, Taken Apart
label: ch:el-minuto-y-el-cuarto
canDo: I can say el minuto, el cuarto, en punto, el horario and la madrugada, and say why the minute and the second are two halves of one Latin phrase.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C342-madrugada: cut an hour into minutes and quarters, give a time on the dot, ask for a timetable, and name the hours before dawn.
